item.tib: rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud las cha lag smad chog gi rim pa
item.coloph: gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen po'i rgyud cha lag smad chog gi rim pa 'di yang / shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing ngo mtshar nor gling du skom (snyom) las pa kun grol grags pa bdag gis bstan sbyin rtsa grogs las slob ma rnams kyi thugs bzhed du bkod pa'o/ sa rta zla 9 tshes la dge'o//
